data.body: Same class, second test (coordinator lead from the almondy-drop-acl-step verify, Nov 19-20): tests/unit/reconciler/state/test_advisory_lock_ref_backend.py::test_pre_pause_decoder_accepts_every_new_pause_blob failed with RefLockTimeoutError on a 'git commit-tree' (via _ref_lock_push.wrap_commit) exceeding _LOCAL_TIMEOUT_SECS. Reproduced with a PATH shim sleeping 5.6 s before commit-tree: origin/main's conftest -> TimeoutExpired 'timed out after 5.0 seconds' on every parameter; with this change's session headroom -> 3 passed. That lead's rerun.log shows 'no tests ran', so the claim that it still failed serially is not supported by that log.
